title: How NFL Teams and Owners Made $23.5 Billion Last Year

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: How NFL Teams and Owners Made $23.5 Billion Last Year
sources.description: The NFL season kicks off this year with teams in all but a handful of franchises seeing a path to the playoffs. Add in the allure of gambling and fantasy football, and it’s no wonder that football is Americans’ favorite sport to watch at 31%, roughly three times basketball (11%), baseball (10%) and soccer (9%), …
